name: Software Developer
description: Designs, builds and maintains software, websites and mobile apps.
courses: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science (Harvard, free on edX)
Python or Java programming course (Coursera / NPTEL)
B.Tech / B.E. / BCA in Computer Science (degree route)

name: Data Scientist
description: Finds patterns in data and builds models that help organisations make decisions.
courses: Machine Learning Specialization (Andrew Ng, Coursera)
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate (Coursera)
Statistics and Probability (Khan Academy, free)

name: UX/UI Designer
description: Designs apps and websites that are easy, useful and enjoyable to use.
courses: Google UX Design Professional Certificate (Coursera)
Figma beginner tutorials (free on Figma's website / YouTube)
B.Des or a design diploma (degree route)

name: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Promotes products and brands online through content, social media, search and ads.
courses: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificate (Coursera)
HubSpot Academy Content & Inbound Marketing (free)
Google Analytics certification (Google Skillshop, free)

name: Business Analyst
description: Studies how a business works and recommends improvements using data and communication.
courses: IIBA Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA)
Excel and SQL for analysis (Coursera / NPTEL)
BBA / MBA (degree route)

name: Healthcare Professional
description: Cares for patients as a doctor, nurse, therapist or other allied health worker.
courses: Biology-focused Class 11-12 followed by NEET-UG for MBBS / BDS / B.Sc Nursing
Allied health diplomas or B.Sc programmes (lab technology, physiotherapy)
First Aid and Basic Life Support certification

name: Teacher / Educator
description: Helps learners understand subjects and grow, in schools, colleges or online.
courses: B.Ed (teacher training degree)
CTET / state TET exam preparation
Teaching with technology short courses (Coursera / DIKSHA)

name: Research Scientist
description: Runs experiments and studies to discover new knowledge in science or engineering.
courses: M.Sc or Integrated M.Sc in your chosen science
NPTEL subject courses (free, IIT/IISc faculty)
GATE or CSIR-NET exam preparation
